label: High-protein (cao đạm) claim threshold for solid foods
unit: g protein per 100 g (or 5 g per 100 kcal)
context: TCVN 14429:2025 (voluntary, from Codex CAC/GL 23): high is twice source (10% of the 50 g NRV per 100 g); TPP-02 target of 10 to 12 g clears it (our calculation)

label: Audited plant-protein foods already meeting the source-of-protein condition per 100 g
context: Retail audit, Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; none carries a protein claim (our calculation)

label: Minimum meat content set by national processed-meat standards
unit: standards with a minimum (of 3 read: TCVN 7049, 7050 and 7048:2020)
context: A 20 to 30% extender can keep the meat product name; for canned meat the maker self-declares the meat share

label: Vissan meat-named formulations printing the named meat share
unit: of 29 unique formulations (named lean 27 to 65% in 21 processed meats)
context: Quantitative-ingredient rule already applied in practice (our count from the package label audit)

label: GMO label trigger against lactoferrin inclusion
unit: % of total ingredients (lactoferrin in a VitaDairy formula: 0.08%)
context: Decree 15/2018 Art 10 and Joint Circular 45/2015; 80 mg per 100 g powder (our calculation), about 60 times below the trigger
